name: West Milford (United States)
description: A black hoist with a red triangle bearing the white monogram WM and two red stars, and a white fly bordered in red bearing a black wheel.
history: West Milford is a town in Harrison County, West Virginia. Flags of the World records the flag as in use since the town's bicentennial and notes that the town uses no seal.

features.role: red triangle at the hoist with a white WM monogram
wheel on the white fly bordered in red
